role: Full Stack Developer Intern | AI Voice
jd:
Employer: Alexander Innovation Centre
Start: January 2027
Term: 4 to 8 months, full-time preferred
Pay: CAD $20 to $22 per hour
Worksite: On-site at 570 Dunsmuir Street, downtown Vancouver, BC


You’ll work with ALEBEX AI engineers to build and test features for a voice AI platform that answers calls, routes requests and hands conversations to staff. You’ll take one well-scoped feature from design through testing and code review with an engineer as your mentor.


What you’ll do
• Build a React or TypeScript interface for configuring or monitoring voice agent workflows.
• Connect the interface to backend APIs and a database. Help build integrations that handle call events, retries and handoffs reliably.
• Test voice workflows in staging, including interruptions, failed transfers and duplicate events. Write regression tests and document what changed.
• Work through code reviews and support releases under engineer supervision.


What you’ll need
• Current enrolment in computer science, software engineering or a related program, and eligibility for the work term.
• One project you can explain from front to back: what you built, how the interface talks to an API, how it handles data and how you tested it. Coursework, a personal project or prior work counts.
• Fundamentals in JavaScript or TypeScript, React or a comparable framework, backend development in Node.js or Python, and SQL or another database.
• Comfort with Git, debugging, basic testing and explaining technical decisions.
• Legal authorization to work in Canada for the term.


Assets
Voice or audio software, telephony, WebRTC, streaming, speech-to-text or text-to-speech, AI agents, or model and workflow evaluation. Prior voice AI experience is welcome.


How to apply
Email a résumé and one project link or short demo to careers@alebex.ai, subject Full Stack Developer Intern | Your Name. Describe your contribution and whether you’re available for four months, eight months or either.

role: 2027 Future Talent Program - Data, AI, and Genome Sciences, Precision Genetics - Co-op
jd:
Job Description

Job Description 

The Future Talent Program within our Research & Development Division Data, AI, and Genome Sciences (DAGS) Department is offering co-op opportunities that last a period of six months. The position is in the Precision Genetics group with focus on phenotyping cardiometabolic diseases. Candidates can apply for the opportunity to be involved in a project designed to enable students to further develop their skills.

Precision Genetics, Cardiometabolic Diseases (1 Position, South San Francisco)



- Develop quantitative and longitudinal phenotypes from EHR using AI/ML methods in large human cohorts 
- Define clinically meaningful patient populations and translate disease concepts into reproducible biobank phenotypes 
- Assist with performing genetic analyses for drug targets identification and prioritization (GWAS, Mendelian Randomization, colocalization)
- Build and maintain reproducible pipelines in cloud workspace 

Required Education and Skills:  



- Candidates must be currently enrolled in a minimum of a Master's degree program in Statistical Genetics, Genetic Epidemiology, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Statistics, or a related field of study. Students enrolled in a PhD program are highly encouraged to apply 
- Candidates must be available to work full-time for 6 months in 2027 as part of a formal co-op program 

Preferred Skills And Experience



- Experience with analyzing large-scale genomic datasets, including GWAS and sequencing data 
- Experience with multidimensional and longitudinal data analysis in biology or medicine and familiarity with medical coding system (ICD, SNOMED, CPT) 
- Experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g., Databricks, AWS) and biobank research analysis platforms (e.g., UKB RAP, All of Us Workbench) 
- Proficiency in Python, SQL, R and experience with machine learning and deep learning methods 
- Track record of scientific communication and of independent research (publications, conference presentations) and strong communication skills 

Please note that this position may be closed before the posted end date or may remain open longer, at the discretion of the company.

The salary range for this role is $39,908 - $111,111
